name: Teen Volunteers at Goleta Valley, Buellton and Solvang Libraries
what_you_do: Earn community service hours at the library. You can help with homework help, kids' craft programs, shelving and cleaning books, and staff projects. In summer many teens help with the Summer Reading Program.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Year-round. No deadline. Openings depend on what each branch needs, so check with your branch.
how_to_apply: Fill out three forms for your branch. They are the teen form, the volunteer waiver and the insurance waiver. Drop them off at the branch. Or email them. Each branch has its own email on the library page.
notes: The Goleta Valley Library also runs the Buellton and Solvang branches. Each has its own forms. The City of Goleta has a separate form for teens who want other city jobs, like park cleanups.
